svg.text: HOW TO ASSEMBLE THE BEAK

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 Trace A and B on orange card and cut them out (cut line = solid black).

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 Crease every dashed FOLD line with a ruler and a blunt pencil/pen.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 A: fold the middle ridge outwards (a roof).

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: B: fold the middle inwards (a valley).

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 Fold B’s side tabs up, glue under A’s sides.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 Fold both base tabs back (90°). Glue them on the mask in the dotted

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: beak boxes on page 1: A on top, B just below.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: Tip: keep the beak rounded — do not crease the tip.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: FINISHED BEAK (sketch — not a cutting line)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: Use 200–300 GSM orange card.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue tabs are 8–9 mm deep so the beak

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: stays firm. Corners are rounded and the tip

text.font-family: Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Mangal, sans-serif

svg.text: is blunt, so it is safe for children.
